findings.source_quote: In Hebrews 11 we read that “…faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen –Hebrews 11:1.”
findings.suggested_fix:
Correct the quoted Scripture to a faithful Swedish rendering. Replace the current sentence text (inside the

that quotes Hebrews 11:1) with a natural, faithful translation such as: “…tro är det som ger verklig livssubstans åt det vi hoppas på, visshet om ting som vi inte ser – Hebreerbrevet 11:1.” (Preserve the tags and spacing/punctuation exactly as in the source HTML.)

findings.source_quote: Jesus promised, “Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth… –John 16:13.”

that quotes John 16:13) with a faithful Swedish rendering such as: “När han, Sanningens Ande, kommer, skall han vägleda er in i hela sanningen… – Johannes 16:13.” (Preserve the tags and spacing/punctuation as in source HTML.)

findings.source_quote: Jesus said to Peter, “O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt? –Matthew 14:31.”
